investigation_notes.Playbook Used: Azure Network Security Group Modification Triage
investigation_notes.Description: An owner-level user performed a virtual network deletion operation against a resource in rg-baltic-test-connectivity at 2026-02-10T12:30:00Z (14:30 EET). The account maps to IT Operations and the source IP is a low-risk mobile ISP from Lagos with a prior related alert that was closed as a false positive after client confirmation the user was working from Nigeria. The target resource group name includes 'test', indicating a non-production environment, and the timing falls within normal business hours in Estonia, so the change is assessed as authorized administrative activity and Low Priority.
